name: l3_hessian_trace
description: Compute per-tile Hessian traces for Tessera L3 sensitivity. Reads a per-tensor calibration bundle (.npz) and writes a hessian-trace policy JSON consumable by tile640_quantize_v3.py --calibration-policy and the L5 orchestrator. Method 'hutchinson' (HAWQ-V2 style, 50 Rademacher probes) requires train_activations; 'exact-diagonal' uses the imatrix's per-channel in_sum2 and is the right choice when only the calibration observer is available.

layers.description: Directory of .npz calibration bundles or a single .npz file.

tile_size.description: Tile width for per-tile aggregation (default 640; must match TILE640_PAGE_SIZE).

n_hutchinson_vectors.description: Number of Rademacher probes for Hutchinson (default 50).

max_tokens.description: Maximum calibration tokens per bundle (default 256; 0 disables).

validate.description: Run validate_policy on the output before exit (also triggered by default).
